facts.fact: 图书馆对峙中他的闭合叙事：她要的是分数，我给了——不再需要我，End of story。
facts.anchor: She wanted a good mark. I gave her that.

facts.fact: 他的底线：上次是他追出去的——这次不追，等她开口。
facts.anchor: But I am not running after her again. Not after what happened last time.

facts.fact: Gemma 抛出真相：演讲崩溃只是表层——她申请奖学金误了截止日，没它就留不下来。
facts.anchor: Her Honours coordinator stopped her beforehand and told her she missed a scholarship application deadline.

facts.fact: 愧疚即时换算：若此事有他一分责任——她会气疯；书稿之外的第二重「分心负债」成形。
facts.anchor: If I had any part in her missing it…Well, she’d be furious.

facts.fact: 同日考场：Contemporary Literature 的考试日=家教服务的终止日、协议的到期日。
facts.anchor: The end date of my tutoring services. The end of our agreement.

facts.fact: 三十排座位外：他一眼认出她身上那件 university jumper——vanilla 香似有若无。
facts.anchor: I would recognise my university jumper anywhere.

facts.fact: 一个 plan 的边角开始成形——「考完再想她」的自我哄骗失败收场。
facts.anchor: The very edges of an idea start to enter my mind.
